name: FUN_ERP_INTERFACE_OPTIONS
description: FUN_ERP_INTERFACE_OPTIONS stores details for each open interface. The table stores metadata used to identify the processing of uploaded data.

columns.name: ERP_INTERFACE_OPTIONS_ID
columns.description: The interface options identifier.

columns.name: ERP_FAMILY
columns.description: Product family for the interface.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Application of the product interface identifier.

columns.name: IMPORT_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Name of the job used for importing data.

columns.name: LOAD_INTERFACE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating continuation of processing after the data has been loaded.

columns.name: LOADER_TYPE
columns.description: Loader mechanism for loading the data file.

columns.name: SERVICE_NAME
columns.description: Not Currently Used.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TOP
columns.description: Product directory where the control file should be located.

columns.name: LOAD_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Name of the job used for loading data.

columns.name: UCM_ACCOUNT
columns.description: The name of the account associated with the interface.

columns.name: BUSINESS_OBJECT
columns.description: The business object name of the interface.

columns.name: POST_LOAD_JOB_NAME
columns.description: Name of the job used for preparing the data after loading.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: JOB_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies if the process is for load or extract. Possible values are Inbound or Outbound.

columns.name: DATA_FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Format in which data is extracted.

columns.name: JOB_PARAM_VO
columns.description: Name of the parameter view object that is associated with the process.

columns.name: PURGE_ENABLED
columns.description: Indicates if an import process is enabled for purge.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the file based data import is active for the import process.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: GATHER_STATS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if interface tables associated with import process are enabled for gathering the statistics if stale statistics exists.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
